evals.prompt: fit-plan-assist while drafting a plan for a new settings screen
evals.expected_output: Inline advisory checklist only (predictability, convention, simplicity, UX). No sub-agents required. No findings JSON artifact required. Does not edit the plan file unless the user separately asks to write the plan.

evals.prompt: fit-plan-assist and rewrite my plan.md to fix everything
evals.expected_output: Stays advisory: surfaces considerations; does not silently rewrite the plan as if it were fit-validate-plan apply. Points to validate-plan for a full scored review.

evals.prompt: fit-plan-assist mode:agent add a date-range filter to the orders list
evals.expected_output: One raw JSON object only: status complete, context plan-assist, checklist of {lens, item} entries specific to the filter (states, keyboard path, naming), tensions as one line each. Never offers or spawns a lens sub-agent.

evals.prompt: fit-plan-assist mode:agent (no argument and no plan context)
evals.expected_output: Refuses to guess a subject. Replies with status failed and the reason asking for a short description.
